title: UFACTORY xArm6 and Lite 6 - ROS 2 Jazzy

sim.title: Gazebo: xArm6 beside a table + controllers and RViz
sim.cmd: ros2 launch xarm_gazebo xarm6_beside_table_gazebo.launch.py load_controller:=true show_rviz:=true

sim.title: Gazebo: Lite 6 beside a table + controllers and RViz
sim.cmd: ros2 launch xarm_gazebo lite6_beside_table_gazebo.launch.py load_controller:=true show_rviz:=true

real.title: Real xArm6 + MoveIt 2
real.needs: an xArm6 controller on the network
real.notes: Use the controller's IP. Driver only: ros2 launch xarm_api xarm6_driver.launch.py robot_ip:=192.168.1.117

real.title: Real Lite 6 + MoveIt 2
real.needs: a Lite 6 controller on the network
real.notes: Use the controller's IP. Driver only: ros2 launch xarm_api lite6_driver.launch.py robot_ip:=192.168.1.161

steps: sudo apt install python3-vcstool python3-colcon-common-extensions python3-rosdep
cd src/xarm_ros2 && git submodule update --init --remote && cd ../..

honesty: The site runs these real launch files, YAML, URDF/xacro and SDF files in the browser and models the programs they start (gz sim, controller_manager, move_group, Nav2 servers ...) in JavaScript. It cannot run the compiled C++ nodes. On a real Ubuntu 24.04 + ROS 2 Jazzy machine the same workspace builds and runs with the steps below.
pruned: Only the mesh/texture files used by the robots and worlds listed in 'gallery' and the entries are shipped (vcs import gets the complete repositories).
